binder.slotTooltip: {{name}} · {{condition}}{{foilSuffix}} — click for details, right-click for actions
binder.reverseSideTooltip: Card on the reverse side of this sheet
binder.dragHint: Drag onto a slot to place · drop a placed card here to remove it
binder.allPlaced: Everything in this binder is placed.
binder.simplifiedTooltip: One page at a time, driven by the keyboard: arrow keys choose a pocket, Enter (or just typing a name) searches for its card

keys.type: start typing a name to search
keys.remove: take the card out (back to Unplaced)
keys.addPage: new sheet after this one (from a back page)

binder.insertFromBack: Page {{page}} is the front of its sheet, and a new sheet can't go between a sheet's two sides. Turn to the back (page {{back}}) and press + to add a sheet after it.
binder.removePageConfirm: The whole sheet this page is on is removed — for a double-sided sheet, both sides. Its cards go back to the Unplaced pool, and the pages after it move up.
